description: Curated taxonomy of RECURRING economic event TYPES. This file contains NO dated instances and is not a calendar. Populating real dated events requires an external feed - see fiboki.marketstate.calendar.USER_ACTION_NOTE.
release_times_caveat: typical_release_utc is the usual UTC clock time under US/EU summer time. Releases follow the issuing country's local clock, so the UTC time shifts by an hour across daylight-saving boundaries. Do not use these strings to date events; they are documentation of the usual slot only.

event_types.name: FOMC Rate Decision
event_types.typical_schedule: 8 scheduled meetings per year, roughly every 6 weeks (Tue/Wed)
event_types.notes: Statement at the top of the hour, press conference 30 minutes later. The press conference frequently moves the market more than the decision, so a blackout ending at T+30m is often too short.

event_types.name: FOMC Meeting Minutes
event_types.notes: Occasionally high impact when the vote split or balance-sheet language surprises.

event_types.name: US Non-Farm Payrolls
event_types.notes: Released with the unemployment rate and average hourly earnings. Historically the single largest scheduled intraday FX move of the month.

event_types.name: US CPI
event_types.notes: Core CPI is watched more closely than headline.

event_types.name: US GDP (advance/second/final)
event_types.notes: The advance print carries most of the impact; revisions rarely move price.

event_types.name: US ISM Manufacturing PMI
event_types.typical_schedule: first business day of each month

event_types.name: ECB Rate Decision
event_types.typical_schedule: 8 scheduled Governing Council meetings per year (Thursdays)
event_types.notes: Press conference at 12:45 UTC. As with the FOMC, the conference often dominates the decision.

event_types.name: Euro Area Flash CPI
event_types.notes: National prints (German, Spanish) leak the direction a day or two earlier.

event_types.name: Bank of England Rate Decision
event_types.notes: Decision, minutes and vote split are released together, so the vote split is an immediate market mover.

event_types.name: UK CPI
event_types.notes: Released before the London equity open; the FX reaction is in thin early-London liquidity.

event_types.name: Bank of Japan Rate Decision
event_types.notes: No fixed release time - the BoJ announces when it has finished, which can be anywhere across a two-hour band. A fixed-width blackout around a nominal time will miss it.

event_types.name: Japan National CPI
event_types.notes: Released on the previous UTC day relative to the Tokyo date.

event_types.name: RBA Rate Decision
event_types.notes: Meeting cadence changed in 2024; a backtest spanning that change sees two different schedules.

event_types.name: Canada Employment Change
event_types.typical_schedule: monthly, usually the same Friday as US NFP
event_types.notes: Collides with NFP, so USDCAD sees both prints in the same second.
